page0.text:
I have to use Archer's arm.
I can't let Rider do this.
Either I surpass my Projection limits, or she'll kill me. It's do or die!

page1.text:
"Trace, on. (Begin Projection.)"
I start up my Magic Circuits, keeping my eyes on Rider.
...I won't Project my weapons until the last possible second.
The instant Rider moves towards me, I'll create a sword in zero seconds flat and intercept her with all my might!

page2.text: "...Projection magecraft. I cannot use you to your full potential, but an excellent swordsman might be able to best utilize you as a Noble Phantasm."

page3.text:
"...?"
Rider's bloodlust recedes.
She withdraws, as if she's read my mind.

page4.text:
"...Rider?"
"I will let you go. I cannot use you.
...What an ironic twist of fate, Shirou. If Saber were still here, she would be an ideal partner for you."

page5.text:
Rider's presence fades away.
She must have left the house right away after she came out of the shed.
Her bloodlust is gone, and it doesn't seem like it'll ever return.

page6.text:
"..."
Did she...let me go?
Unless I'm imagining it, she might have offered to help me if I'd given her a chance...
